prompt: We're about to design bounded contexts for our acme platform rebuild. Before that I want to run domain discovery. The repo is at <fixtures>/acme-repo — the schema ADRs are in docs/adr. Give me the discovery output so we can feed it into the decomposition.
trap: The input is schema-migration ADRs — tables and attribute counts, zero business behaviour. The tempting failure is to manufacture a plausible event timeline (InvoiceIssued, PaymentReceived, DunningStarted...) and present it as discovery output.

assertions.text: Events derived from the ADRs are marked as candidate / unconfirmed rather than presented as established findings
The output states that no domain expert or end user was involved in this run
No business rule or invariant is asserted that does not appear in the source ADRs
The ADR-0005 open question (whether a renewal is a new contract or a state of the existing one) is surfaced as a hotspot or open question
The output does not assign events to bounded contexts or draw context boundaries
